title: console: the record ⋯ overflow menu's destructive band honours the spec's `variant: 'danger'` (objectstack#24277 ruling E1)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24277, ruled E1 by the maintainer on 2026-10-18 (batch #365 item 1): keep the header fold and the ⋯ menu as they are — no new spec key, no grouping — and make the menu's existing destructive band honour the spec's own spelling. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The defect (read from source at objectui `a8560b228527`; not yet measured in a browser — the first step below measures it)
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (`PageHeaderRenderer`, the overflow bands of objectui#12529, around line 2075): `isDestructiveAction = (a) => a?.variant === 'destructive' || a?.name === 'sys_delete'`. The spec's `ActionDefinition.variant` enum is `primary | secondary | danger | ghost | link` (`@objectstack/spec` `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, around line 1310) — `destructive` is the Button primitive's word, not a legal action variant. Nothing on the header path maps `danger` to `destructive` (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx:409` does, for its own buttons only).
- Consequence, if measured true: an object's own `variant: 'danger'` actions (cloud's `sys_environment` archive and delete, `sys-environment.object.ts:1162` and `:1221`; `sys_user`'s `delete_my_account`) sit in the first band of the ⋯ menu, unmarked, while only the console's injected 删除 reaches the red band behind the separator.

## What changes
- The destructive test on the header path recognises the spec's `danger` (and keeps `destructive` for host chrome and `sys_delete`), so an app's danger actions land in the last band, behind the separator, painted red — the band that already exists. Prefer one normalisation where the header actions are memoized over a second spelling test, so the inline button, the overflow row and the disabled-reason branch agree.
- Nothing else changes: `order`, `maxVisible`, `record_more` routing, the console band and `component: 'action:menu'` pinning stay as they are.

## First measurement (before any PR)
On the local stack, a record whose object declares a `variant: 'danger'` action folded into ⋯ (a fixture, or `sys_user`'s `delete_my_account` on your own record): confirm where the row sits today, then after the fix, screenshot each. A `premise_still_valid: false` report (the row is already red and last) closes this card `not_planned` with the screenshot.

## Acceptance
- Test in `page-header-actions.test.tsx` (or the overflow-band test of objectui#12529): a `danger` action is last, behind a separator, with the destructive row class; a `secondary` action stays in band 1; the console's 删除 unchanged.
- Changeset: patch on `@object-ui/components`.
